description: This source file defines a REST API resource for managing two-factor authentication (2FA) in the system. It includes endpoints for retrieving available delivery methods, requesting OTP tokens, validating OTP tokens, and invalidating sessions.

classes.name: TwoFactorApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource for two-factor authentication management, including endpoints for delivery methods, OTP requests, validation, and token invalidation.

methods.name: getOTPDeliveryMethods
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve available 2FA delivery methods for the authenticated user.

methods.name: requestToken
methods.description: Handles POST requests for requesting a new OTP token via specified delivery method; optionally extends access token.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to validate an OTP token and generate an access token.

methods.name: updateConfiguration
methods.description: Handles POST requests to invalidate a current two-factor access token session.
